# GoLearn assets used by Euclid Elements

The GoLearn JavaScript bridge is bundled from the local GoLearn source checkout recorded in `golearn-build.json`.

## Koine Greek form index

The Koine Greek form index is based on MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition, version 6.12, edited by James K. Tauber
([source](https://github.com/morphgnt/sblgnt); [DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.376200)). The source components have separate terms: the SBL Greek New Testament text is CC BY 4.0 (Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software; [SBLGNT](https://github.com/Faithlife/SBLGNT)), while MorphGNT morphological parsing and lemmatization are CC BY-SA 3.0 ([license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)). Headword glosses in the index are from Biblia's Greek lexicon inputs, attributed there to Dodson, Abbott-Smith, and Strong's public-domain lexicons. Septuagint counts are used only as counts, not as glosses.

The source token readings are grouped by normalized form and lemma/POS into a compact index; polytonic marks are preserved and grave accents are folded to acute. No analysis is generated by this repository. This is a combined dataset; the text, morphology, and gloss source terms above remain separate.
